1_generez_nip_ci_dessus: 1. Generate a PIN above for each employee: it lands in their space automatically.
3_apos_employe_tape_nip: 3. The employee types their PIN, sees their name, punches — the screen resets for the next one.
apos_employe_pourra_reafficher_lui: The employee can show it again from My space, with their password.
arrondi_punchs_localisation_borne_partag: Punch rounding, location and shared kiosk.
arrondit_heure_entree_sortie_pas: Rounds the in and out times to the nearest step. “None” keeps the exact minute.
deja_envoye_espace_notez_seulement: Already sent to their space. Note it only if you must hand it over in person.
dela_total_hebdomadaire_heures_comptees: Past this weekly total the hours count as overtime and payroll pays them at 1.5x. Week runs Sunday to Saturday.
employe_ne_peut_pas_afficher: The employee cannot show it — replace it
nip_actuel_cessera_fonctionner: Their current PIN stops working right away. The new one shows once — write it down so you can hand it over.
personne_ne_pourra_plus_poinconner: This person can no longer punch at the shared kiosk.
plein_ecran_tablette_laissee_place: full screen on the tablet left on site.
position_actuelle_utilisee_comme_centre: The current position is used as the centre of the area
position_gps_demandee_navigateur_jointe: The browser is asked for the GPS position and it is attached to the punch. A refusal never blocks the punch.
refuse_punchs_faits_hors_rayon: Refuses punches made outside the radius. Kiosk punches are never blocked.
tablette_laissee_place_ouvre_kiosque: A tablet left on site opens /kiosque: the employee types their PIN and punches, with no personal session.
timeclock_settings_view_generer_et_envoy: “Generate and send” assigns a PIN and notifies the employee in their space — no message to write. Only they can then display it, with their password.
timeclock_settings_view_les_employes_hor: Employees outside the zone will no longer be able to punch from the web. Check the coordinates before saving — a badly placed zone blocks everyone.
verifier_centre_zone_google_maps: Check the centre of the area on Google Maps
